dimensions.assessment: Affects non-supervisory attorneys employed by the Board of Veterans' Appeals.
dimensions.evidence: An individual employed by the Board as a non-supervisory attorney may be promoted to grade GS-15 of the General Schedule.

dimensions.assessment: Provides a potential pay grade increase (GS-15) to improve recruitment and retention of board attorneys.
dimensions.evidence: to reform and enhance the pay of Board of Veterans' Appeals attorneys for recruitment and retention

dimensions.assessment: Involves potential federal pay adjustments for certain attorneys, but no specific spending amounts are provided.
A focused amendment to a single subsection of title 38, United States Code, regarding attorney pay grades.
dimensions.evidence: Section 7101A(b) of title 38, United States Code, is amended...

dimensions.assessment: Permanent change to the career and pay structure for Board attorneys.
dimensions.evidence: An individual employed by the Board as a non-supervisory attorney may be promoted to grade GS-15 of the General Schedule.

missing_information: Exact number of attorneys eligible for GS-15 promotion.
Total fiscal cost of the proposed pay enhancements.
importance_detail.rationale: Amends title 38 to allow non-supervisory attorneys at the Board of Veterans' Appeals to be promoted to grade GS-15 for recruitment and retention.
